row.compilation_source: Lane D2 (2026-09-14). **There is no forecast.yaml row for IS4**: B1 classified it `class 1` under the *legacy* 15-operator algebra (`benchmarks/ldbc-fit-v1/classification.json`: `need_or_ops: entity_history`) — one of the three templates the 15 operators express on their own — so it was never forecast as a TGIR row and never carried an artifact.
row.note: NodeScan(uids=[$messageId], labels=[Post,Comment]) -> Project. Two primitives, the shortest plan in the suite; a class-1 row stays several nodes fewer than a class-2 one, which is the whole shape of the 3 -> 24 result. `Message` is the bind-time labels **union** [Post, Comment] (§2.1 / §8.17 / FREEZE §7.4): TGIR-v1 has no label hierarchy, so the supertype is a union list, never subtyping. `messageContent` is §2.7's `coalesce(content, imageFile)`, matching the template's `coalesce(m.content, m.imageFile)` — a Post carries `imageFile` and a Comment does not, so the second arm is null-valued on Comments and the first is null-valued on image Posts. `messageCreationDate` is the **property** `creationDate`, never the version's `vt_s`; the legacy `entity_history` compilation read it as `vt_s`, and substituting one for the other silently is exactly the class of error §A9's alias discipline exists to stop. No Order and no Limit: the template has neither, and `(m:Message {id: $messageId})` is a single identity.

provenance.schema_note: Column names and their order are the reference template's RETURN list, verbatim.
provenance.params_note: `$messageId` is the LDBC `Message` id encoded through `snb_uid('Message', id)` at bind time (`scripts/ldbc_snb_params.py::bind`, §A4). Its LDBC source is `validation_params-sf1.csv`'s `messageIdContent` (the driver's `LdbcShortQuery4MessageContent` accessor `getMessageIdContent()`, `interactive_v1/common/.../QueryStore.java:484`). The frozen value here is a `stores/ldbc-fixture` anchor, as every checked-in artifact's `params` are.
